source: composer-feature.jsx (mounts on OxideMX - Composer.html; theme via freya-data.jsx makeTheme(); icons in icons.jsx; tweaks via tweaks-panel.jsx)
note: Agent-facing translation contract for the extracted prompt-composer feature. Read this INSTEAD of parsing the JSX. Tokens resolved for the default cyan accent; alternate accents (Tweaks) regenerate every <base>_<NN> token via makeTheme(). The composer is docked as the footer region of a minimal mock thread so it reads in-context.

theme.alphaRule: T.<base>_<NN> = <base hex> + <NN> for NN in [0c,10,12,14,16,1a,1c,1f,22,26,33,3a,40,44,50,55,66,88]; generated by makeTheme() after the accent override. Per-attachment tones (blue/green/peach/teal/mauve/accent) read T.<tone>_16 fill + T.<tone>_33 border dynamically.

components.name: Composer
components.note: Stack: activityLine? · Card{ resizeGrip? · predictionStrip? · attachmentChips? · editor · toolbar }. Reset-on-send clears editor + attachments + manualHeight.

children.name: ActivityLine
children.note: model name · thinking level · tool/optimizer status · '/ for commands'. Hidden when tweak activity=false.

children.name: ComposerCard
children.note: Border → accent_33 while a menu is open.

children.name: ResizeGrip
children.note: Pointer-drag top grip. Appears when content is scrollable (isLong) or a manual height is set. Drag sets manualHeight, clamped [capPx, 520]; capPx = lineCap*23 + 6.

children.name: PredictionStrip
children.note: gboard-style. Shown when tweak prediction=chips and editor non-empty. Up to 3 chips; first chip is accent-tinted. predict() returns mode=complete (autocompletes the partial word from COMPLETIONS) or mode=next (next-word from NEXT map). '⇥ tab' hint accepts the first.

children.name: AttachmentRow
children.note: Shown when attachments.length>0. Each chip is removable.

children.name: Editor
children.note: Uncontrolled contenteditable, line blocks (div.cline). Auto-grows to maxHeight=capPx then overflow:auto; manualHeight overrides. Caret color = accent. Placeholder overlay when empty.

behaviors.newline: Shift+Enter (or Enter when sendOnEnter=false) splits the current cline at the caret.
behaviors.markdown: On space (tweak markdown=true): line-start #/##/### -> md-h1/2/3 block class; *x* -> strong, _x_ -> em, `x` -> code, ~~x~~ -> s. Markers are consumed.
behaviors.ghost: tweak prediction=ghost renders a faded contenteditable=false suffix span (.ghost) of the top completion at line end; Tab accepts.

children.name: AttachButton
children.note: Rotates 45deg into an x when its menu is open.

children.name: ProviderPill
children.note: Shows current model name + provider icon + thinking-level badge (L/M/H) + chevron.

children.name: SendButton
children.note: Disabled (surface1/faint, no shadow) when empty & no attachments; working -> stop (surface2/red).

children.name: AttachMenu
children.note: Floats above the + button (bottom:100%, marginBottom:8). Outside-mousedown closes. Sources: Upload file, Reference repo file, Image / screenshot, Paste from clipboard, Code snippet, Camera — each appends a sample AttachmentChip.

children.name: ProviderMenu
children.note: Two views: models | settings. Floats above the provider pill. Outside-mousedown closes.

children.name: ProviderGroup
children.note: Gemini · Claude · Local LLM group headers (icon + tone).

children.name: SettingRow
children.note: settings view: 'Send on Enter', 'Prompt optimizer'. Footer note points prediction/lineCap/markdown to Tweaks.

components.name: MockThread
components.note: Host frame: slim header (project + worktree chip) · ScrollView transcript · Composer footer. Backdrop = radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%, T.bg1, T.bg2 60%, T.bg0).

animations.name: rotate
animations.drives: AttachButton + glyph 0->45deg when its menu opens

classes.wide: >=1180 — full composer; provider pill shows model name + thinking badge; prediction strip inline.
classes.compact: 920-1179 — provider pill collapses to icon + thinking badge (name hidden); line hint hidden.
classes.tablet: 600-919 — composer spans full width; attach + provider menus open as bottom sheets (Popup, anim drawer) instead of floating popovers.
classes.phone: <600 — full-bleed; prediction strip horizontally scrolls; attach + provider menus are bottom Sheets; resize grip hidden (auto-expand cap only); send is a full-width-friendly 44px target.

responsive.phoneNav: n/a (single surface — this is a feature file, not the app shell)
touchSubstitutions: Floating popover menus (AttachMenu / ProviderMenu) -> bottom Sheet (data-freya=Popup, anim sheet).
Top-edge drag-to-resize grip -> hidden; rely on auto-expand cap.

lineCap.note: max visible lines before the editor scrolls

markdown.note: live inline markdown render on space

activity.note: show the status line above the card
